objects.description: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has leveraged [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002) DCSync feature to obtain user credentials.(Citation: Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023)
objects.description_fa: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) از ویژگی [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002) DCSync برای به دست آوردن اعتبار کاربری استفاده کرده است.(Citation: Palo Alto Unit42 STATELY TAURUS TONESHELL September 2023)
